post.description:
基于 task_id 撤销/中断 Celery 异步任务。

    terminate: 若任务已开始，是否通过信号强制终止

    撤销结果

post.description:
Execute a search2title agent with user and project constraints.

This agent combines research (supervisor_agent) and title generation (write_agent)
in a two-phase workflow to directly output news titles based on a research brief.

Ensures only one search2title agent runs per user per project at a time.
If project_id is not provided, uses user's default project.

get.description: Get the status of a search2title agent task.
List search2title agent tasks for a user.

post.description: Cancel a running search2title agent task.

get.description: Get the current LangGraph state for a running search2title agent task.

post.description:
Generate news titles based on research brief and web search data.

This endpoint directly exposes the title generation agent with structured output,
providing bottom-up data flow for the research agent architecture.

Args:
    request: Title generation parameters including research brief and search data
    
Returns:
    Structured title generation output with metadata and timing information
